testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel inserting a model-state table row: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/model-browser-published-snapshot/checkout/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:1505:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel inserting a model-state table row ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user creates an undimensioned rectangular sketch and extrudes it 1 in with zero taper ✔ And the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State and activates Copy State ✔ And the user sets extrusion suppression in Primary and Capture State and leaves it computed in Copy State ✔ And the user opens the model-state table with d0 included ✔ And The MCAD Software has a model-state table with Primary, Capture State, and Copy State in that order ✔ And Capture State has extrusion status Suppress and d0 value 1 in ✔ When the user opens the context menu on the Capture State row number ✔ Then Insert Row and Delete Row are available ✔ And the default-row, parameter-range and column commands appear disabled ✔ When the user chooses Insert Row ✔ Then a generated member row appears immediately after Capture State ✔ And the new row shows extrusion status Suppress and d0 value 1 in ✔ And OK is enabled ✔ When the user cancels and reopens the table ✔ Then only the original three member rows are shown in their original order
